name: workfromphone
description: Phone-first operating mode for completing Codex work while away from the computer.

interface.shortDescription: Finish Codex work remotely from your phone.
interface.longDescription: Keep Codex tasks usable when your phone is the only interface. Codex handles workstation actions autonomously, avoids assigning desktop chores, delivers files and images through mobile-reachable channels, keeps image batches compact-safe, and preserves continuity through long sessions.
defaultPrompt: Use $workfromphone to finish this task while I am away from my computer.
Use $workfromphone and deliver every output in a phone-friendly format.
Use $workfromphone to continue autonomously with compact progress updates.
